_notes: 14818: Ps 105(Vulgate)=Ps 106:4(思高). 思高 uses singular 我 while the Latin breviary text uses plural nostri/nos (communal prayer context); followed 思高 wording verbatim as instructed. 14819: Composite liturgical antiphon conflating Jn 14:1 (Non turbétur cor vestrum → 你们心里不要烦乱), Jn 14:28/16:28 (ego vado ad Patrem → 我往父那里去), and Jn 16:7 (cum assúmptus fúero a vobis, mittam vobis → 当我被从你们中接走后，我要差遣他到你们这里来). The phrase 'assúmptus fúero a vobis' (when I shall have been taken up from you) is not a direct single-verse citation but a liturgical conflation; rendered using 思高 wording for identifiable clauses and bridged naturally.
